@section l35-35 | Unit 35 | Vocabulary practice · Unit 35 | 文意字彙・選擇題・配合題
@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。本單元請抽查：部分句子左側邊緣被切到，開頭文字依語意補回；Q12、Q13 的人名（Tom / Dan）為補回。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Never a______n your pets in the wild. It is not only cruel to them but also bad for the environment.
= abandon
~詞義 abandon（v.）遺棄
~原文 Never abandon your pets in the wild. It is not only cruel to them but also bad for the environment.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Mr. Wang is a kind and generous man who often donates money to c______y.
= charity
~詞義 charity（n.）慈善機構
~原文 Mr. Wang is a kind and generous man who often donates money to charity.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Billy was having such a wonderful time at his friend's place that he was r______t to leave.
= reluctant
~詞義 reluctant（adj.）不情願的
~原文 Billy was having such a wonderful time at his friend's place that he was reluctant to leave.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: For me, living downtown is very convenient, but it has its l______ns. For instance, I don't have a garden of my own.
= limitations
~詞義 limitation（n.）侷限
~原文 For me, living downtown is very convenient, but it has its limitations. For instance, I don't have a garden of my own.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Artists often devote their lives to the p______t of beauty by experimenting with countless styles to create better work.
= pursuit
~詞義 pursuit（n.）追求
~原文 Artists often devote their lives to the pursuit of beauty by experimenting with countless styles to create better work.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: In the meeting, teachers discussed to what ______ digital devices could be used in classrooms without distracting students.
A: agent
B: intention
C: extent
D: obstacle
= C
~詞義 extent（n.）程度
~原文 In the meeting, teachers discussed to what extent digital devices could be used in classrooms without distracting students.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: During the storm, officials ______ traffic away from flooded areas to prevent accidents and keep drivers safe.
A: resembled
B: routed
C: negotiated
D: deserved
= B
~詞義 route（v.）(按規定路線)安排
~原文 During the storm, officials routed traffic away from flooded areas to prevent accidents and keep drivers safe.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The road was under construction, so the workers put up a(n) ______ to stop vehicles from going down it.
A: agency
B: barrier
C: candidate
D: expansion
= B
~詞義 barrier（n.）障礙物
~原文 The road was under construction, so the workers put up a(n) barrier to stop vehicles from going down it.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Steven's rude remarks have deeply ______ many people. No wonder he has few friends.
A: absorbed
B: coped
C: offended
D: ensured
= C
~詞義 offend（v.）冒犯
~原文 Steven's rude remarks have deeply offended many people. No wonder he has few friends.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The saying "Don't put all your eggs in one basket" means that you should not ______ all your money in one place.
A: obtain
B: invest
C: limit
D: expand
= B
~詞義 invest（v.）投資
~原文 The saying "Don't put all your eggs in one basket" means that you should not invest all your money in one place.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: apparently
B: earnest
C: mutual
D: declared
E: published
F: earnestly

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: ______, Johnny had a bad day. He came home with a frown and didn't want to say anything at all.
= A
~詞義 apparently（adv.）明顯地
~原文 Apparently, Johnny had a bad day. He came home with a frown and didn't want to say anything at all.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Tom's first novel was ______ when he was only 20 years old.
= E
~詞義 publish（v.）出版
~原文 Tom's first novel was published when he was only 20 years old.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Dan made a(n) ______ attempt to complete the difficult assignment on his own.
= B
~詞義 earnest（adj.）認真的
~原文 Dan made a(n) earnest attempt to complete the difficult assignment on his own.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The whole family was excited when the doctor ______ that the baby was healthy enough to leave the hospital and come home.
= D
~詞義 declare（v.）宣布
~原文 The whole family was excited when the doctor declared that the baby was healthy enough to leave the hospital and come home.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Allen first met Sally when their ______ friend, Larry, introduced them to each other at a party.
= C
~詞義 mutual（adj.）共同的
~原文 Allen first met Sally when their mutual friend, Larry, introduced them to each other at a party.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: phenomena
B: capacity
C: accompanied
D: intimate
E: distributed
F: primitive

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The new concert hall has a seating ______ of more than 1,000, and it will open to the public next month.
= B
~詞義 capacity（n.）容量
~原文 The new concert hall has a seating capacity of more than 1,000, and it will open to the public next month.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Lindsey and Michelle are ______ friends, so they share everything about their lives with each other.
= D
~詞義 intimate（adj.）親密的
~原文 Lindsey and Michelle are intimate friends, so they share everything about their lives with each other.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: In the past, people couldn't explain the reasons behind many natural ______, but now, we can understand them better because science has progressed so much.
= A
~詞義 phenomenon（n.）現象
~原文 In the past, people couldn't explain the reasons behind many natural phenomena, but now, we can understand them better because science has progressed so much.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The teacher gave us a bag of sweets, and we ______ them evenly among ourselves.
= E
~詞義 distribute（v.）分發
~原文 The teacher gave us a bag of sweets, and we distributed them evenly among ourselves.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The singer's performance was ______ by soft piano music that created a peaceful and emotional atmosphere.
= C
~詞義 accompany（v.）伴隨著
~原文 The singer's performance was accompanied by soft piano music that created a peaceful and emotional atmosphere.
